ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white interior covering approximately 85-90% of the visible surface area against a low-intensity black perimeter margin.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white central field (RGB: ~240,240,240); contiguous black bordering (RGB: ~20,20,20) along the entire trailing edge and distal margins; isolated small circular black focal points (spots) scattered within the white field of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated pixel angle of approximately 52 degrees; notch depth occupies roughly 15% of the total vertical height of the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) distributed uniformly along the trailing edge boundary; amplitude varies between 5-15 pixels from the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the proximal trailing edge transitioning to a convex outward sweep towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Massive, dense clusters of circular, high-contrast, heterogeneous brown/white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) localized on the extreme left and right distal tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned grey linear pixel disruptions visible on the inner-right lobe surface, oriented diagonally relative to the midline.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme distal tip colonization/encrustation resulting in irregular, jagged geometric silhouettes; dark, irregular pigmentation patterns localized around the insertion point of the fluke (peduncle attachment area).
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of cascading water droplets creating vertical linear pixel streaks extending from the trailing edge and tips into the lower water background.
